headline: AI & Data Systems Engineer | Full-Stack Developer
shortBio: Aspiring AI and data systems engineer pursuing a B.S. in Computer Science at University of Minnesota. Passionate about developing data-centric workflows, building scalable web applications, and applying LLMs to solve real-world problems.

children.text: I'm an AI and data systems engineer with a strong foundation in full-stack development and machine learning. Currently pursuing my B.S. in Computer Science at the University of Minnesota-Twin Cities, with an expected graduation in Spring 2028. My passion lies in building data-centric workflows that power modern AI applications.

: I focus on practical applications of AI and data engineering, from developing responsive user interfaces to designing robust backend systems. I believe in writing clean, maintainable code and solving real problems with technology. My experience spans startups, research environments, and full-stack development.

: I develop full-stack applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript on the frontend, with backend work in Python and Rust for data processing. I specialize in generative AI integration, dataset curation, prompt engineering, and building data pipelines. Currently, I'm working on BOOM (Burst & Outburst Observations Monitor), a Rust-based logging middleware for astronomical data processing at the University of Minnesota.

When I'm not coding, I'm exploring new technologies, contributing to research projects, and mentoring other students. I'm always excited to learn and collaborate on projects that have a real-world impact.
